findings.title: Claim is being deleted while pods still use it
findings.cause: the pod mounts PersistentVolumeClaim data, which was deleted 10m0s ago and is kept only while pod db-5dfdd6b46d-2ddc8 still uses it (the kubernetes.io/pvc-protection finalizer), so the scheduler will not place a new pod that needs it; when it stops, the claim goes; Deployment db has 1 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: PersistentVolumeClaim data has a deletionTimestamp (2026-11-25T14:08:33Z) and finalizers kubernetes.io/pvc-protection
evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pvc-deleted-in-use -o jsonpath='{.metadata.deletionTimestamp}{" "}{.metadata.finalizers}'

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: persistentvolumeclaim "data" is being deleted. not found

findings.fix: A deletion cannot be undone. To keep the data, set the claim's PersistentVolume to persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain before the last pod using data stops; then create the claim again (bound to that volume) and the pod can start. If the delete was meant, remove the pod's use of the claim.
